title: Richard Feynman: The Beauty of the Flower
summary: A two-minute 1981 interview clip in which Richard Feynman answers an artist friend who claims science takes the beauty out of a flower. Feynman argues that understanding adds to beauty and mystery.
why: HN cites it whenever someone worries that explanation or analysis spoils wonder, as a compact statement that knowledge deepens appreciation.

quote.text: being analytical about the world makes its beauty shine more, not less
